include: Evaluating numerical expressions with fractional bases and negative powers
assessmentEmphasis: Simplifying complex expressions showing all working steps clearly.
questionStyleNotes: Use a mix of variables and fractional numerical bases.

exclude: Systems with zero solutions (unless testing the discriminant)
assessmentEmphasis: Rigorous algebraic substitution and clearly identifying both (x, y) coordinate pairs.
questionStyleNotes: Provide one equation already isolated to a variable where possible to start easy, then progress.

include: Evaluating limits of difference quotients for polynomials up to degree 3
exclude: Differentiation from first principles of trigonometric or exponential functions
assessmentEmphasis: Demonstrating clear algebraic substitution and limit evaluation steps.
questionStyleNotes: Always provide the definition formula in the question or hint.

assessmentEmphasis: Transforming root/fractional forms to index form before differentiating.
questionStyleNotes: Mix standard polynomial terms with terms having negative coefficients and fractional powers.

exclude: Combining chain rule with product/quotient rule in early stages
assessmentEmphasis: Correctly identifying the inner and outer functions.
questionStyleNotes: Include questions where the inner derivative produces a constant that needs careful factoring.
